button.notes: Direct mapping. Use data-* attributes for state styling. Support variant/size via className callback.

checkbox.notes: Compound pattern. Use CheckboxGroup for grouped checkboxes. data-checked attribute for styling.

radio-button.notes: RadioGroup wraps Radio items. Use data-checked for selected state styling.

toggle-switch.notes: Simple compound. data-checked for on state. Animate thumb position via CSS.

slider.notes: Full compound component. Support range (multi-thumb) via value array.

text-input.notes: Wrap Input in Field compound for label/error. Use data-invalid for error state.

textbox.notes: Same as text-input. TextBox is the Form Elements page variant.

tooltip.notes: Wrap app in Tooltip.Provider. Use Positioner for placement. Arrow is optional.

tabs.notes: Compound tabs. value prop for controlled. data-selected for active tab styling.

tab.notes: Navigation page Tab maps to same Tabs compound component.

accordion.notes: Supports single or multiple open. data-open for expanded state.

toast.notes: Provider at app root. Use toast.add() API. Support severity variants.

dialog.notes: Modal dialog. Backdrop for overlay. Traps focus automatically.

modal-dialog.notes: Same as dialog. Modal Dialog is the Modals page variant.

modal-single-multi.notes: Single/multi-page modal uses Dialog with internal step state management.

dropdown-single.notes: Full compound select. Positioner for dropdown placement. data-selected on options.

dropdown-combo.notes: Combo box variant. Add text input in trigger for filtering.

dropdown-multi.notes: Multi-select. Track selection array. Render tags for selected items.

search.notes: Search uses Input with icon prefix and clear button. Add Popover for suggestions.

progress-bar.notes: Simple progress. Use value prop. data-complete when 100%.

scroll-bar.notes: Custom scrollbar styling. Supports horizontal and vertical.

segmented-button.notes: Use toggleMultiple=false for single-select segmented control.

overlay.notes: Overlay/Drawer. Use Dialog without modal prop for slide-over panels.

tag.notes: Custom component. Dismissible chip with label and optional close button. Style with Synapse tokens.

link.notes: Native <a> element styled with Synapse tokens. No Base UI primitive needed.

masthead.notes: Compose from Toolbar pattern + NavigationMenu. Custom header bar with logo, nav, actions.

left-nav.notes: Vertical nav with collapsible sections. Compose NavigationMenu + Collapsible.

app-launcher.notes: Grid-style popover. Use Menu for structure, custom grid layout inside popup.

dropdown-menu.notes: Direct Menu mapping. Support submenu via nested Menu. data-highlighted for hover.

global-alert.notes: Page-level notification. Can also use Toast for auto-dismissing variant.

inline-alert.notes: Dismissible inline alert. Collapsible for show/hide animation.

wizard-modal.notes: Multi-step dialog. Internal stepper state management. Use Dialog shell with custom step content.

power-filter.notes: Filter panel in popover. Compose form elements inside popup.

stepper.notes: Step indicator. Use Progress for visual bar + custom step circles.

date-time-picker.notes: Calendar popover + input. Custom calendar grid inside Popover.Popup.

dual-list-box.notes: Two scrollable lists with transfer buttons. Compose 2x ScrollArea + Button.

form.notes: Form composition with validation. Use Field compound for each input.

breadcrumb.notes: Nav breadcrumb. Use Separator between items. Semantic <nav> with <ol>.

pagination.notes: Page navigation. Compose Button + NumberField for page input.

badge.notes: Notification badge. Custom component with Synapse tokens. Position absolute on parent.

table.notes: Custom table with Synapse tokens. Semantic <table> with sortable headers.

data-grid.notes: Custom data grid. Consider wrapping TanStack Table or AG Grid with Synapse styling.

tree.notes: Recursive tree structure. Nested Collapsible components for expand/collapse.

filter-panel.notes: Custom filter panel. Side panel with form elements for data filtering.

detail-panel.notes: Custom detail/inspector panel. Slide-in panel showing row details.

columns.notes: Column configuration component for data grid. Custom implementation.

spinner.notes: CSS animation spinner. Use Synapse tokens for color. role='status' + sr-only text.

skeleton-loader.notes: CSS animation skeleton. Pulsing placeholder blocks matching content layout.

chat-area.notes: Custom chat container. Scrollable message list with auto-scroll.

chat-input-box.notes: Custom chat input. Textarea with send button and attachment support.

chat-system-response.notes: Custom AI/system message bubble. Supports markdown rendering.

chart-widget.notes: Custom chart wrapper. Card shell with header and visualization area.

line-chart.notes: Custom line chart visualization. Consider D3 or Recharts with Synapse tokens.

topology.notes: Custom network topology visualization. D3 force layout with Synapse styling.

tracker.notes: Custom progress/status tracker. Visual status indicator with steps.

error-card.notes: Card variant for error states. Custom component with error icon and message.

empty-dashboard-widget.notes: Empty state placeholder for dashboard widgets. Icon + message + CTA.

page-layout.notes: Custom application shell layout. Masthead + Left Nav + Content area composition.
